notes.title: 1.8.0 Update - Endless Mode
notes.content:
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7079101/Rage%20Runner/full%20sized%20cover.jpg

Rage Runner 1.8.0 - Endless Mode
We are proud to announce the release of version 1.8.0.

What's New
The main highlight of this release is Endless Mode which features procedural level generation, a larger trench and all sorts of other cool stuff!https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7079101/Rage%20Runner/endless.jpg

COMPETITION
Compete on the Daily Level and pass the corpses of other crashed players. Score in the top 3 at the end of the day and you can unlock the fastest ship in the arsenal!
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7079101/Rage%20Runner/tappy.jpg

JOYRIDE
Want to kick back and relax with some nice tunes? Try out joyride mode, where everyone's always a winner! This mode is great for children! 3 gold stars guaranteed ;)
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7079101/Rage%20Runner/joyride.jpg

CHANGES
The old Rage Runner is still here but you'll find it tucked away in PRACTICE mode. Further changes:

 Added 11 Achievements
 Added 5 Leaderboards
 Added 4 official levels - These were originally available on Steam Workshop but have been added to the game for higher visibility.
 Various bug fixes

notes.title: Version 1.7.2 Live
notes.content:
Rage Runner

FIXED Multiple connected gamepads are now handled properly. If you previously were disconnecting extra controllers just to play, we apologize :(
ADDED Workaround for Mac font rendering on ATI cards. See discussion thread on Font Workaround.


Arc

ADDED Optional setting to force player 1 to use keyboard/mouse.
FIXED Keyboard/mouse menu navigation shortcuts.
FIXED Generic gamepad button and axis mappings.
FIXED Menu navigation and state issues on entry screen, main menu & armory.
FIXED Test room item browser not triggering for players 2-4.
FIXED UI aspect ratios to prevent items getting cut-off on square-er resolutions.
FIXED No longer allow zero length names.
FIXED Allow bypassing press start screen with any button or click.
UPDATED Respawn points and triggers to prevent z-depth issues after death in Marcio and Test Room.

notes.title: Version 1.7.0 Live
notes.content:
Version 1.7.0 is now live!

New

You can now delve deeper into the Arconian backstory by playing Arc, the first title in the Hyper Arcade Bundle!
Defeat the evil Blockubus and you'll unlock the nimble Arconian ship in Rage Runner!
We now have a public Roadmap where you can vote on items that you'd like to see next in Rage Runner. Join the community discussion here on Steam to let us know what features you want. Then cast your vote on The Rage Runner Roadmap.

Fixed

Allow exiting the keybinding screen even if all keys are not bound.
Alternate camera views no longer get messed up after explosions.

notes.title: Version 1.6.6
notes.content:
Achievements

 The achievement for collectibles on Level 7 has been reduced to 55%. We know that the achievement is called "C's Get Degrees" but in this case we'll accept an F+.
 # of deaths required for Resilience III has been reduced from 1000 to 250.


Changes

 We decided to remove the level gate. The upside is that if you were stuck on a level, you can finally check out the other cool levels and soundtracks.
 Added a retry button on the win screen for those doing highscore runs.


Bug Fixes

 Better gamepad support for non-xbox 360 controllers that use XInput. Please leave feedback if your gamepad has unmappable buttons and we will continue to improve this.
 Fix issue that prevented leaderboards from displaying when level was won.

notes.title: Version 1.6.0 is Live!
notes.content:
We lied, we're a few days early!

New Features
The primary feature of this release is the level editor with Steam Workshop integration. You'll find 3 new levels in the workshop that we created to kick things off.

Be sure to check out our new video on the store page for a brief introduction to the level editor along with the official level editor docs.

Leaderboards
You can now browse highscore leaderboards in-game. Additionally, all community created levels have their own unique leaderboard!

Bug Fixes

 Properly restore fullscreen/windowed mode setting

notes.title: Release Schedule Update
notes.content:
Hey folks. We wanted to get our first major update on the radar.

Release 1.6.0 is scheduled for June 20th

New Features

 Level Editor with Steam Workshop support
 New Levels
 Easier leaderboard access
 Major bug fixes


The level editor and steam workshop integration is a huge effort on our part. So although this feature list may look slim, it is sized based on a reasonable estimate of how much we can get done.

Thanks to those that are submitting bugs, please continue to submit them so we can track and prioritize them. Towards the end of the first week of June, we may be asking willing people to opt-in to our beta to help test the editor.

notes.title: 1.5.3 Live - Small Bugfixes & Workshop Prep
notes.content:
We have just pushed out a minor update that fixes some reported bugs. It also takes us a step closer to having workshop support. 

A huge thanks to all that have been posting enhancement requests, problem reports and recommendations. We hear your requests and they are officially on our todo list.

Bugfixes

 Fix an issue that caused controller type to continually get reset to gamepad if a gamepad was plugged in.
 Some settings screen items were not refreshing with localized text when the language was changed.


Other Changes

 Broke game assets up into smaller self-contained modules in preparation for Steam workshop support.
 Culled 2 MB worth of unused game assets.

notes.title: 1.5.0 Beta 3 Live
notes.content:
Beta 3 is now live on Steam. You can see the version of your build at the bottom of the main menu.

Fixes

 Package the correct steam plugin with the game. We accidentally packaged the debug version which couldn't load on non-dev boxes. Now achievements etc will work.
 Prevent game from responding to input while steam overlay was active.
 Prevent game from freezing when entering keybind menu while game is paused.
 Level 8 - The scale of spike obstacles has been reduced to the correct size.
 Level 9 - Fix activation distance and animation of spikes. Space out powerups at start to indicate how many there are.


Changes

 Reduce lifetime of missile smoke trail for improved visibility.
 Add new sound effect for shield activation.
 Disable mouse cursor and the unintended ability to navigate half of the UI with the mouse.
